caption: The drawing is composed of three horizontal sections framed by a decorative border of pink flowers with green leaves and stems on a black background. The top and bottom borders also have a pink and white geometric pattern. In the top section, there are large pink flowers and green foliage against a black background. The middle section, separated by a thin pink border, depicts two horsemen at either end—one on the left with a white horse and one on the right with a brown horse—both with blue attire and hats. Between them is a large eagle holding a green, white, and red flag (with "Recuérdame" written on it), perched above green foliage, surrounded by blue birds and plants, all on a black background. The bottom section, separated by a blue and gold stripe, contains an urban scene: several multicolored buildings in red, blue, yellow, white, and black with domes and towers among green trees, all set against a black background. In the foreground is a grassy area with various animals including swans (red, black, white), ducks, and horses. Toward the right, a blue river or lake contains two small boats with green, white, and red flags. The overall composition utilizes a vibrant palette dominated by pink, green, black, blue, red, and white, with repetitive elements and decorative floral patterns.
title: Painted Chest, Michoacan
